source.note: BLOCKED: an RCSTR with Ziegler-Natta polymerization kinetics (70 reactions, five catalyst sites, POLYSL equation of state, polymer component attributes) cannot be run on any backend in this repository. Recorded as an answer key. The VAPOR product stream is not printed in the chapter. The text's first-run MWW (7.194163E6) disagrees with the printed DPW (254569) by 0.73 percent, and the text says 97.94 percent where 5525.38/5700 is 96.94 percent: see the architecture doc
